_comment: MCP resource spec for #12 Should I Hire a PM Yet? Phase 2 .mcpb bundle target. Draft — MCP Apps spec (Jan 2026) is young; owner to validate before locking.

_app.name: Should I Hire a PM Yet?

resource.name: Should I Hire a PM Yet?
resource.description: Five-input diagnostic for founders. Returns yes/no/not-yet, the type of PM to hire, the wrong-fit cost, and an interim playbook if it's not yet.

tools.name: hire_pm_yet_diagnose
tools.description: Deterministic. Returns the verdict + pm_type + interim_playbook_id from the five inputs. Does not call an LLM.

tools.name: hire_pm_yet_narrate
tools.description: LLM-narrated. Takes the diagnostic output and inputs, returns the four-section reading: verdict, PM type (or interim playbook), wrong-fit cost, signals that would flip the answer.

user_inputs.description: The five original inputs verbatim so the narration can reference specifics.

tools.name: hire_pm_yet_drift
tools.description: MCP-only (stateful). Compares the current diagnostic to a previous run and reports what shifted. Default off — requires opt-in.
tools._phase_note: Web/URL-trick versions don't expose this tool. State requires the MCP App AND user opt-in.

_open_questions: Validate ui:// URI scheme against current MCP Apps spec.
Confirm enum-with-null is acceptable in MCP outputSchema (or refactor pm_type/interim_playbook_id to optional fields without nulls).
Decide whether the link to #38 from a 'yes' verdict is a separate tool call or embedded as a clickable artifact in the narration output.
